approval_basis: The user explicitly instructed the assistant to complete remediation according to the stated recommendations. The D-02, D-05, D-12 and MR-43 dispositions select those recommendations; D-01, D-03, D-04 and D-06 through D-15 adopt the canonical plan's explicit recommended resolutions for this candidate.
identity_and_signature_limit: This is a decision record derived from explicit chat authorization. No cryptographic signature or external identity-provider verification was available; it does not by itself satisfy a production trust controller's signed owner-attestation requirement.
scope: Candidate engineering, schema design, local validation and evidence preparation only. Does not authorize push, merge, CI/CD, deployment, spend, credential expansion, policy waiver, promotion or a production-readiness claim.

decisions.title: canonical sources
decisions.decision: Prose specification controls normative intent; canonical machine-readable schema/policy/case registries control executable data; rendered/embedded copies are generated. Any mismatch blocks candidate validation until reconciled.
decisions.basis: Canonical plan recommendation adopted for candidate engineering.

decisions.title: North Star hierarchy
decisions.decision: Retain HRAS-NS-001 through HRAS-NS-005 as the only top-level canonical North Stars for rc4. Map proposed excellence, user-effort, frontier-awareness, artifact-hygiene, diagnose-repair-retest, and validated-user-outcome concepts to measurable sub-requirements and existing North Stars. Do not add a new top-level North Star or renumber requirements in rc4; reassess only in a separately versioned governance decision if a genuinely independent acceptance gate is demonstrated.
decisions.basis: Explicit recommendation chosen after user authorized completion.

decisions.title: status taxonomies
decisions.decision: Keep artifact lifecycle, module result, test result, workflow state, external operation state, validation status, and delivery status as distinct typed taxonomies. No cross-family coercion is permitted.
decisions.basis: Canonical plan recommendation adopted for candidate engineering.

decisions.title: INCONCLUSIVE
decisions.decision: Propagate INCONCLUSIVE through case results, aggregates, reports, adapters and controller. No non-PASS status satisfies a required release gate; unexecuted/unmaterialized remains NOT_RUN or BLOCKED according to reason.
decisions.basis: Canonical plan recommendation adopted for candidate engineering.

decisions.title: exception and release semantics
decisions.decision: An exception is acceptable only when independently approved, unexpired, scoped, policy-waivable and supported by evidence; it never converts FAIL/NOT_RUN/INCONCLUSIVE into PASS and never waives a non-waivable condition. Any release that relies on an exception must be DONE_WITH_GAPS; PRODUCTION_READY, DEPLOYED_AND_VERIFIED, and MASTERPIECE_VERIFIED require zero exception-based waivers. MASTERPIECE_VERIFIED allows no exceptions.
decisions.basis: Explicit recommendation chosen after user authorized completion.

decisions.title: state machine ownership
decisions.decision: One versioned machine-readable transition registry is the source of workflow transition edges. The reference controller consumes it and rejects unknown modes, unknown states, forbidden edges and terminal-state re-entry. Workflow, operation, and delivery state remain separate.
decisions.basis: Canonical plan recommendation adopted for candidate engineering.

decisions.title: QualityProfile immutability
decisions.decision: Freeze and hash applicability, hard gates, targets, comparator set and thresholds before evaluation. Any change creates a new profile/hash and invalidates impacted evidence; profiles may add, never remove, baseline or non-waivable gates.
decisions.basis: Canonical plan recommendation adopted for candidate engineering.

decisions.title: MASTERPIECE semantics
decisions.decision: MASTERPIECE_VERIFIED is an evidence-backed evaluation state, not an award or universal superiority claim. Require applicable gates, fresh artifact-bound evidence, product acceptance criteria, an independent comparator/review, workflow_state DELIVERED, and no blockers, unverified items or exception-based waivers.
decisions.basis: Canonical plan recommendation adopted for candidate engineering.

decisions.title: user validation fallback
decisions.decision: Use representative user-task validation where feasible and authorized. Otherwise use clearly labelled proxy methods; proxy evidence never supports a claim of empirical human research and does not silently waive applicable gates.
decisions.basis: Canonical plan recommendation adopted for candidate engineering.

decisions.title: retry and convergence
decisions.decision: Use durable, bounded global/project/task budgets and attempt accounting. Repeated identical failure signatures require a strategy pivot after three occurrences; four repetitions block the item. No resetting counters to evade budgets, and thresholds cannot be expanded after observing failures.
decisions.basis: Canonical plan recommendation adopted for candidate engineering.

decisions.title: domain agnosticism
decisions.decision: Select quality profiles from product class, user context, risk, scale, target environment, data sensitivity and constraints. No illustrative product class becomes the default mandatory feature set or benchmark majority.
decisions.basis: Canonical plan recommendation adopted for candidate engineering.

decisions.title: policy-registry packaging
decisions.decision: The version-pinned multi-file package is the normative publication unit for rc4. HRAS_v20_Policy_Registry.json is the only canonical policy source. Annex B is explanatory and generated from the registry; it is not a separately maintained policy authority. Missing, stale, unapproved or hash-mismatched policy fails closed.
decisions.basis: Explicit recommendation chosen after user authorized completion.

decisions.title: schema freeze sequencing
decisions.decision: Design all schema changes in the contract phase; freeze the registry atomically only after requirements, controller interfaces, reports and tests reconcile. Any post-freeze schema change creates a new version/hash and invalidates dependent validation results.
decisions.basis: Canonical plan recommendation adopted for candidate engineering.

decisions.title: independent domain oracle
decisions.decision: Derive domain oracles in an isolated process/container with OS-enforced source-read exclusion; permit only approved requirements, contracts, axioms and independent reference vectors. Isolation must be audited, not asserted by prompt text.
decisions.basis: Canonical plan recommendation adopted for candidate engineering.

decisions.title: blocked-integration adapter semantics
decisions.decision: Use typed live and contract-verified sandbox adapters. Sandbox use must be explicit, environment/profile scoped, visibly marked non-live, and prohibited from satisfying live-integration or production gates.
decisions.basis: Canonical plan recommendation adopted for candidate engineering.

decisions.title: LifecycleAndOperabilitySpec proposed synthesis
decisions.decision: Adopt MR-43 as P1, profile/risk/applicability-scoped. Define a typed LifecycleAndOperabilitySpec and require operational evidence only for applicable components, with explicit non-applicability rationale; required lifecycle evidence blocks the delivery statuses it governs.
decisions.basis: Explicit recommendation chosen after user authorized completion.
